faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is this a final binding construction quotation?
faq.a1: No. MallorcaQuotes provides an indicative construction estimate based on standard regional parameters. Actual prices vary with exact site topography, soil geotechnical reports, structural engineering, and specific finishes selected with your chosen contractor.
faq.q2: Does the estimate include the plot purchase price?
faq.a2: No. The calculation covers solely the construction costs of the building, pool, exterior landscaping and optional professional fees. Land acquisition and notary/property registry costs are excluded.
faq.q3: Does it include architect fees and building licences?
faq.a3: Architectural fees, project management and municipal building permit fees (ICIO and municipal taxes) can be optionally included by toggling the Project & Licences option (+10% indicative benchmark).
faq.a4: No. MallorcaQuotes is an independent estimation and lead platform, not a building company. We help you establish a realistic budget before you engage architects or contractors.
faq.q5: Is the calculator free of charge?
faq.a5: Yes. Both the Quick Calculator and the Detailed Estimate dossier are completely free for prospective homeowners and self-promoters.

disclaimer.title: Important Estimation Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: This calculation is an indicative estimate based on the information provided and current market benchmarks in Mallorca. It does not constitute a formal, binding contractor quotation. Final construction costs may vary according to topographical conditions, municipal urbanistic regulations, structural demands, and contractor contracts.
